id: title:Gilbert09:retry cloudinary s non standard 420 rate limit

review.posthog_relevance: Cloudinary warehouse ingestion recovery; the change explicitly adds Cloudinary-specific handling for status code 420, promoting it to a retryable action and passing response hooks to warehouse API calls, allowing the ingestion worker to recover from Cloudinary's non-standard rate-limit responses.
review.reason: Adds Cloudinary-specific 420 status handling and shared response hooks, passing retry actions and response hooks to warehouse API calls. This connects the retry configuration to warehouse resource and usage requests, allowing recovery from Cloudinary 420 responses.
review.uncertainty: While the code demonstrates the implementation of a recovery mechanism for Cloudinary 420 responses, the actual benefit depends on Cloudinary returning 420 status codes and the ingestion worker successfully recovering, which are not independently verified. No production incident or adoption is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is requested.
